python3 -c '
import urllib.request, os
urls = [
    ("https://www.myinstants.com/media/sounds/fart.mp3", "core/fart_classic.mp3"),
    ("https://www.myinstants.com/media/sounds/cartoon-fart_1.mp3", "core/fart_cartoon.mp3"),
    ("https://www.myinstants.com/media/sounds/long-fart.mp3", "core/fart_long.mp3")
]
for url, path in urls:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            data = resp.read()
            if len(data) > 500:
                with open(path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(data)
                print("Downloaded", path, len(data))
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error for", url, e)
' && ls -lh core/fart*.mp3
